answer: Pin each identity to a serial thread of work: every output cites the hash of the one before it, so nothing parallel can be forged as sequential. A rotating set of harbor notaries timestamps each link, making order tamper-proof and cheap to replay. Any identity that cannot clear a harbor gate on time is parked in the lagoon pool, where its earnings settle late and skip the epoch. To run N fakes, an attacker must push N threads through a bottleneck of serialized harbor attestations and eat the lagoon delay on every one, so fleet output grows slower than headcount and its rewards never compound.
